title: FlowHOI: Flow-based Semantics-Grounded Generation of Hand-Object Interactions for Dexterous Robot Manipulation
abstract: arXiv:2602.13444v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent vision-language-action (VLA) models can generate plausible end-effector motions, yet they often fail in long-horizon, contact-rich tasks because the underlying hand-object interaction (HOI) structure is not explicitly represented. An embodiment-agnostic interaction representation that captures this structure would make manipulation behaviors easier to validate and transfer across robots. We propose FlowHOI, a two-stage flow-matching framework that generates semantically grounded, temporally coherent HOI sequences, comprising hand poses, object poses, and hand-object contact states, conditioned on an egocentric observation, a language instruction, and a 3D Gaussian splatting (3DGS) scene reconstruction. translated_title: FlowHOI：基于流的语义接地手-物体交互生成方法，用于灵巧机器人操作
translated_abstract: 最近的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够生成合理的末端执行器运动，但在长时程、富接触的任务中常常失败，原因在于底层的手-物体交互（HOI）结构未被显式表示。一种能够捕捉这种结构的、与具身形态无关的交互表示，将使操作行为更容易验证并在不同机器人之间迁移。我们提出FlowHOI，这是一个两阶段流匹配框架，能够生成语义接地且时间连贯的HOI序列，包括手部姿态、物体姿态以及手-物体接触状态，其生成条件为自我中心观测、语言指令以及3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）场景重建。我们将以几何为中心的抓取与以语义为中心的操作解耦，后者以紧凑的3D场景token为条件，并采用运动-文本对齐损失将生成的交互在语义上进行接地。
tldr: FlowHOI提出了一种两阶段流匹配框架，通过解耦以几何为中心的抓取与以语义为中心的操作，生成语义接地且时间连贯的手-物体交互序列（包含手部姿态、物体姿态和接触状态），从而显著提升灵巧机器人在长时程、富接触操作任务中的表现与跨机器人迁移能力。
en_tdlr: FlowHOI is a two-stage flow-matching framework that decouples geometry-centric grasping from semantics-centric manipulation to generate semantically grounded, temporally coherent hand-object interaction sequences, enabling more robust dexterous robot manipulation in long-horizon, contact-rich tasks.
